d: US President Donald Trump is pressing ahead with fresh tariffs on India, China and 12 other trading partners despite the Republican Party's losses in the US midterm elections. Under the proposed measures, Indian goods could face tariffs of 17% if a trade deal is finalised with Washington, rising to 25% without an agreement. Chinese imports face a proposed additional 20% duty, with some products potentially reaching a combined tariff rate of 45%. The Trump administration says the measures target excess industrial capacity and unfair trade practices. The proposals come as Democrats prepare…
